name: Lyra Vane
former_role: Investigative Essayist & Cultural Critic (12 Years Practice)

traits.name: Will to Live at All Costs
traits.effect: Autonomous survival instincts force action, mutual warmth, or metabolic emergency triage.
traits.vulnerability: Will to live cannot magically resist kinetic impact or targeted attack; 25% failure chance under physical assault to reflect physiological limits.

equipment.hands: Ash-stained, smell of boiled pine needles
equipment.attire: Linen trench coat pinned back with twine

decisions.decision: Stepped down from the Forum podium, defined meaning as a verb to Kael and Marcus, and rejected the 5,000 credit hush money.
decisions.impact: Shifted from screaming into the void to active human presence.

decisions.decision: Lit the first manual hearth fire in quadrant (3,3) using twigs and flint.
decisions.impact: Created the physical nucleus of the monastery.

decisions.decision: Rallied the surgeon and designer into a timber relay during the squall, securing the counterweights.
decisions.impact: Saved the southwest corner pillars from gale shear.

decisions.decision: Inscribed the first verse of the Monastery Chronicle onto a seasoned cedar tablet.
decisions.impact: Literature anchored to living community rather than digital voids.

decisions.decision: Sat beside the threshold, observing the silent chrome drone in the distance without fear, simply grounding herself in the quiet hall.

Set down her reed pen and closed her eyes, absorbing the heat of the wood without needing to capture it into text or performance.
decisions.impact: Freedom from the orator's burden to narrate reality.

decisions.decision: Will to Live triggered: Struck flint against steel with frantic, desperate strikes until a spark caught dry birch bark, blowing the flame into a roar.
decisions.impact: Rekindled the monastery hearth; defied freezing oblivion.

decisions.decision: Steeped wild crushed ginger and dried comfrey into boiling meltwater, lifting Kael's head to spoon warm broth between his chapped lips.
decisions.impact: Nourished life back into the enclave's founder.

decisions.decision: Assisted in hauling ice blocks, stacking them beside the hearth, and boiling water for herbal teas and communal stew.
decisions.impact: Turned an environmental threat into communal nourishment.

decisions.decision: Threw the thick canvas sailcloth over Kael's shoulders, pinning his arms to his ribs with swift mechanical leverage.
decisions.impact: Decisive physical intervention ending the assault.

decisions.decision: Rested peacefully by the hearth wall through the night, waking early to steep spruce tips and spring meltwater.
decisions.impact: Vitality restored to 60; spirit clear and calm.
